title: AIR Communities (Apartment Income REIT) notifies people that an unauthorized party acquired files with their data
date_note: The day of the notice letter (dated November 16, 2026), also the California Attorney General's Reported Date. The company says it became aware of the incident on 26 August 2026.
geo_basis: headquarters address on the notice letter (4582 S. Ulster St., Denver, CO)
summary: AIR Communities (Apartment Income REIT LLC) says in a 16 November letter filed with California's Attorney General that it learned on 26 August 2026 of unauthorized access to a limited part of its technology environment, and from 16 October found people's personal information in files the unauthorized party acquired. It notified law enforcement, reports no data misuse, and offers 24 months of Experian IdentityWorks. The letter lists 16 Rhode Island residents notified.
plain: An apartment company says someone got unauthorized access to part of its computer systems, found in August, and took files with some people's personal details. It is offering two years of identity protection.
exec: Confirmed data theft at a US apartment REIT; people whose data was in the acquired files face identity-theft risk.
action: AIR Communities' letter urges recipients to enroll in the offered Experian IdentityWorks membership by February 26, 2027, and to review account statements and credit reports for suspicious activity.
impact: Total number of people affected not stated; the letter lists 16 Rhode Island residents notified.

sources.name: California Attorney General: Apartment Income REIT LLC breach notification
AIR Communities notice of data breach (sample letter, 16 November 2026)

report.publisher: Apartment Income REIT LLC (filed with the California Attorney General)
key_findings: On August 26, 2026, AIR Communities became aware of unauthorized access to a limited part of its technology environment.
Beginning on October 16, 2026, it identified personal information in files acquired by the unauthorized party.
It notified law enforcement and has received no reports of data misuse.
recommendations: Enroll in Experian IdentityWorks (24 months) by February 26, 2027; review statements and credit reports.

evidence.quote: Additionally, in an abundance of caution and in response to the incident, we are providing you with access to Experian IdentityWorks for 24 months.
There were 16 Rhode Island residents notified in this incident

validation.note: Primary: AIR Communities' own notice letter of 16 November 2026, filed with and published by the California Attorney General (register entry sb24-633010, breach date 08/26/2026, reported 11/16/2026). No other publisher read.
